titles.native: 一騎当千 集鍔闘士血風録

description:
Immediately following the events of "Ikkitousen: Xtreme Xecutor", the kids from Nanyo Academy head to Kyoto for a school trip. Before long, they run into rival classmates from other Kanto schools and find themselves confronted by Kyoto's best fighters. It's a battle of epic proportions. Hopefully the city of Kyoto will be left standing!

(Source: IMDB)
